text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm out shopping with Taiki Shuttle on<n>a day off,
when...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Sigh... What should I do? This wholetrip is going to be a waste if I don't—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy, Flower! You sure look<n>anxious about
something.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's nothing serious. I just can't<n>decide which
clothes to buy.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Heck! If that's all it is, I'll help ya out.<n>Fashion's
way more fun with a<n>friend to shake up your style!
☆

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: To shake up... my style?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh! Yes, please! I'd love it if you'd<n>join me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Wow! These diamond shoes areabsolutely gorgeous! Just look at'em sparkle! You gotta try these on!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Diamonds?! On me?! I... I...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ta-daaah! ☆ Tell me this ain't the<n>coolest wetsuit ya
ever seen! It'd be<n>perfect for a rainy day! ☆

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what?! You mean you'd wear<n>something like
this out on the street?!<n>Talk about a bold fashion
statement!<n>Too bold for me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Now, leeet's see! ♪ What should we<n>try next? ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Pant... You've got so much energy...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: No! Actually, I'm feeling really<n>inspired!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The reason I wanted to go shopping<n>today is... Well,
it's because I wanted<n>to find clothes that would
make me<n>look more grown-up.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But once I started looking at outfits, it<n>felt like
nothing really suited me, and I<n>felt too shy to try
anything on...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
That's why Taiki is so amazing! It's<n>like she can
pull off any look.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, honey, you've got it all wrong! It<n>doesn't take
skill to rock an outfit...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: It takes heart!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That's what I said! Take this outfit for<n>example—it
just shouts "active!" and<n>"cheerful!" It's all about
matchin' the<n>occasion! ♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What's yer heart tellin' ya, Flower?<n>What kinda
outfit and mood are ya<n>aimin' for?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: What kind of mood... Hm...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I want something... kind... that brings a<n>smile to
everyone's face. I want to<n>be like a blooming
cosmos flower!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Bam! Now yer talkin'! Hold onto that<n>feelin'!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If that's the kinda outfit you want,<n>then that's the
outfit you should get!<n>I'm certain it'll look like it
was made<n>just for you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Okay! Then... I'm gonna go look<n>through the
shops one more time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle and I sit back and watch<n>as a smiling
Nishino Flower runs off<n>to find her new outfit.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Darn right she does! It'd be a crying<n>shame if she
wasn't, seeing as<n>she's out shopping! ♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Which reminds me... A certain<n>somebody hasn't
picked out a single<n>thing!
choice_data_list: I guess I could buy something!
I dunno... This month's been kind of tough...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Woohoo! I was hopin' you'd be onboard! ☆ Now hurry up and spill thebeans on what's in your heart.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What was your mood comin' out with<n>me today?
choice_data_list: I was excited, just like you.
I was excited, just like you.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Just like me?! You mean your heart<n>and mine are...
In other words...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You wanna get matchin' outfits?!
choice_data_list: Who said anything about matching outfits?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I know! Let's get a top with super<n>frilly sleeves!
And do you remember<n>those pants with all the
hearts?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: We need to get to the fitting room,<n>like, right now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having misunderstood my intentions,<n>she runs off
to buy an outfit. This<n>throws me into a panic, and I
give<n>chase!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I hear ya loud 'n' clear. No worries.<n>I'll foot the bill
today!

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry. It appears that your card is<n>maxed out...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You're kidding!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Looks like we're both poor as churchmice, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What're you sorry for? I'm about as<n>happy as a
pig in mud right now!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
We might not have matchin' outfits,<n>but we sure as
all get-out have<n>matchin' hearts! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, we head back to the<n>academy, cheerfully
chatting about<n>the day we had.
